notes.title: Legrand Legacy v2.0 - New and Improved!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8d06d279ebfe11c111f355031218d215ebeb2cbf.jpg[/img]
Hello, Legrandians!

Thanks to the feedback and recommendations from you guys,  we’ve finished our complete rewrite of the games script, fixed a few bugs, and straightened out other minor issues, and today… the motherlode finally hits our Steam store. 

That’s right, the all shiny, all new and improved Legrand Legacy v2.0 drops today! If you’re wondering what this means for your gaming experience, read on.

[h1]MAJOR CHANGES TO COMBAT AND BATTLE SYSTEM
[/h1]We have replaced the old battle system completely and re-coded from the ground up. This massive update includes:

	a. Significant improvements to combat camera and new impact effects
You will see that camera movements during battles have been upgraded with dynamic angles and we’ve added fancy impact effects to make your heroes feel all the more badass.
			
	b. Difficulty selection
We included a difficulty selection to cater to your needs. Want to enjoy the story but think the combat is too hard? Play on “easy” and breeze through your adventure. Up for a hardcore challenge and want to put your gaming skills to the ultimate test? Play on “hard!”
		
	c. ACT mode option (easy or off/automatic)
After a lot of feedback, we discovered that some of you don't like to have to press the ACT with every turn, so we’ve added the option to make the ACT dial easier OR to turn off the ACT completely and make it automatic instead.

	d. Updated enemy AI
While updating the code of our combat system, we discovered that some of the enemy AI did not work as intended. We have fixed those problems. 

	e. Rebalanced most of the combat
After fixing the enemy AI, implementing a new difficulty selection, and the automatic ACT, we have also updated the combat balance to fit the new AI. Enemies are smart but not too smart!

	f.  Move command no longer takes a character's whole turn
You will now be able to perform an action after moving and not waste a character's whole turn just to reposition.

	g. Improved Arcana cinematics
We have improved the cinematic sequence during Arcanas so they’re more dramatic. We’re talking about some SERIOUS eye candy here, people.
	
[h1]GRAPHICAL IMPROVEMENTS
[/h1]We have modified the old shaders so the new shaders now enable normal maps, which means more refined and prettier details on the 3D model textures. 

[h1]COMPLETION OF SCRIPT REWRITE AND EXTENDED ENDING
[/h1]Following our announcement about our attempt to rewrite the script, this update completes the revised writing. You can now enjoy Legrand Legacy’s newly rewritten and polished script in its entirety. Plus, we have also extended the ending with additional cutscenes to clarify the conclusion of our heroes’ story.

[h1]SKIPPABLE CUTSCENES
[/h1]During cutscenes, you can now press the cancel button and then the confirm button to skip the current cutscene entirely.

[h1]TACTICAL WAR QUICK RETRY
[/h1]Now when you lose a tactical war, there will be a prompt so you can try it again.

[h1]OTHER MINOR BUGS
[/h1]As always, we have also fixed other minor bugs.

******* SPOILER ALERT *******
There is a break and save point in Crimson Canyon (chapter 8), so you can pause and take a breath between the tactical wars and boss battle marathon.

Finally, we thank you for being supportive and vocal of the improvements you wanted to see! We may be a small studio, but we hope that we have been able to respond to your feedback quickly enough. We can’t wait to hear what you think about this new update, so don’t forget to LEAVE YOUR COMMENTS after you’ve tried the new and improved Legrand Legacy v2.0.

Oh and positive reviews would be lovely too!

notes.title: Introducing Our Publishers, Release Date Update, and Discord!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! The past few weeks have been pretty busy and intense (in a good way) for everyone at the studio, but we haven’t forgotten about you. In fact, we have some very exciting updates regarding Legrand Legacy’s release!  

[h1]Introducing… Our Publishers![/h1] 

We’re thrilled to announce that we are partnering with two esteemed publishers for the release of Legrand Legacy. [b]ANOTHER INDIE[/b] will be working with us for our worldwide launch, while [b]MAYFLOWER ENTERTAINMENT[/b] will be taking care of our South Korean players. You might have heard of [url=http://anotherindie.com/games/]Another Indie[/url] from other premium games, like Lost Castle and Sinner, so we're looking forward to working with them on Legrand Legacy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/e1df5fdf832b3434e3259279fc6e334f566a4bfd.jpg[/img][i]Watch out world![/i]

[b]What does this mean for you?[/b]

Well, this means that Legrand Legacy will be coming to you in [b]English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, Korean,[/b] and a few [b]more languages[/b] planned in the near future. This also means that you will be seeing more of us in [b]upcoming events[/b], like GDC or PAX East, so we can say hi to you face to face. Lastly, we hope you’re looking forward to a ton of [b]swags, giveaways, and freebies[/b] for Legrand Legacy’s launch because we’ll have LOTS of them!  

[h1]Release Date & Discord[/h1]  
Our current goal is to release Legrand Legacy for Windows [b]some time in January 2018[/b]. We’re still ironing out the details so we don’t have an exact date yet. 

In the meantime, we've set up an [b]official Discord[/b] (discord.gg/ai) and we cordially invite you to hang out with Henry, AJ, and me, along with fellow Legrand Legacy players for some pre-launch fun. If you have any questions and suggestions about Legrand Legacy or life as a gamedev in general, please don't hesitate to drop by!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/dcaf623f9468594dbaea765c5cd1d27dc745162f.jpg[/img][i]Come hang out with us :)[/i]
 
[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

These partnerships are a HUGE deal for us because it means that Legrand Legacy will be able to reach MORE players worldwide, so we hope that you’re as excited to read today’s update as we are. We do have a few more surprises in store, so stay tuned for the next update! 

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

This also means that you will be seeing more of us in [b]upcoming events[/b], like GDC or PAX East, so we can say hi to you face to face. [h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

-Revinia & the SEMISOFT team-

Hi everyone! These past few weeks were filled with many bug squashing sessions in the studio, while Henry & AJ went from airport to airport, all in the name of spreading the Legrand Legacy love. In this update, we'll be sharing some snapshots from our showcase in Gamescom & PAX West.

BUT BEFORE WE START...

[h1]Legrand Legacy on GOG![/h1]

We proudly announce that Legrand Legacy is confirmed to be available via [b]GOG.com[/b]! We know some of our backers are avid DRM-free gamers so we hope you're happy to hear this.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/4a8e4b399d9a48465838e7ab9115c9f06908ce5b.jpg[/img][i]GOG gamers rejoice![/i]

[h1]Gamescom - Germany[/h1]

We often hear that Gamescom is one of the BIGGEST gaming conventions in the entire world. Well, that is 100% positively true. There were ELEVEN massive halls filled with games, people, and more games. Special thanks to [b]Indie Arena Booth[/b] for being a gracious and generous host.

Here comes the highlights!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/944d13b416511b13a8460cd189001161ae9d4107.jpg[/img][i]One of the most fascinating things about Gamescom was the strict age rating. We got a rating of 16+ so our booth had to be covered by this special grey wall.[/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/3824dfc2e34d127f7a9a0ebfee24e6cd0b2835b3.jpg[/img][i]Whoever says gamers like to stay at home?[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/530f1340337d511bbea1e9b0ca58caf816a1ca81.jpg[/img][i]
The Indie Arena Booth has the best setup! Monitors, headphones, and keyboards were provided so we didn't have to pack much from home.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/81bc3239a51cf302cc073e7c2b6d80a5a04dd98b.jpg[/img][i]
Let's play hack & slash![/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/69942f68fcdd01d76155a23bad3233b9026b84ec.jpg[/img][i]This guy went on our hall of fame for setting the high score impossibly high, making it harder for PAX West to beat our challenge![/i]

[h1]PAX West - Seattle[/h1]

First and foremost, we want to say a big THANK YOU to one of our very own backers, [b]Jason Risk[/b], for cosplaying as Kefka and taking a break from destroying the world to help us out at PAX. We'd also like to thank [b]Indie Megabooth[/b] for being a wonderful host and to [b]Intel[/b] for sponsoring our booth and laptops. Special hugs to [b]Anya from Kickstarter[/b] for inviting us to Media Indie Exchange (the MIX) and to [b]Yaprak from GameJolt[/b] for having us in your EPIC party with DreamHack!  

Now here comes the pictures!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/92bbf52e6b45404f9b517d9f71d9759ef8148593.jpg[/img][i]Thank you Kefka... Jason... for being the most eye catching and helpful volunteer ever. Hope you enjoyed PAX in all its crazy, crowded glory![/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/306a7d32e65fd87b742548a46672c2c45caddb9f.jpg[/img][i]Our booth was packed like this EVERY DAY. We had to draw lines on the floor so people can wait in line to play. Thanks to Intel for the laptops and gears![/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8afaa49fae38c2e3787cf740ab3b4ddf91698460.jpg[/img][i]We were nominated Best Indie Game by Marooners' Rock![/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/f254f836dc86c67409aef8dfd327637abaecaa85.jpg[/img][i]Thanks for playing guys, we hope you like the t-shirts![/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/29092028fd8e7c4d969dca2a6ee301d6c34a889c.jpg[/img][i]The cosplay, oh the cosplay, but this guy was our favorite, hands down! Sephiroth FTW![/i]
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/205a0474fc8be8d9a7dc588922a0adba07a4fc65.jpg[/img][i]Behind every successful event, there's a worn out dev who just needs to lie down :D[/i]

[h1]Support These Kickstarter Projects![/h1]

We know first hand that running a Kickstarter is time consuming and NOT easy. So whenever possible, we show our support to promising projects and we hope you will do so too!

First up is [b]Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond[/b], a role-playing game that combines turn-based tactical combat with a story of questionable morals. These guys are NOT Kickstarter newbie and this game is the continuation to their first Kickstarter project, Celestian Tales: Old North.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ekuatorgames/celestian-tales-realms-beyond

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/215/380/b3427e8317acea94fdae2fada5b46c74_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1504696502&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0a540fe8b393023a85f64c43e0bb420e[/img][i]Celestian Tales' art was inspired by watercolor brush strokes.[/i]

notes.title: Early Access Keys // Volunteers for PAX West // We're Going to Gamescom Germany // Last Chance for Backers Survey!
notes.content:
[h1]TL;DR[/h1]

Hi everyone, this week's update is filled with a bunch of wonderful news, but if you have less than 1 minute, here's the TL;DR

✔️ Check your email for [b]early access keys[/b]
✔️ We're looking for a [b]volunteer[/b] to help us in [b]PAX West[/b] Seattle, USA (Sep 1-4)
✔️ We're also going to [b]Gamescom[/b] in Cologne, Germany (Aug 22-26)
✔️ [b]Backers' survey[/b] will be closed on August 19th (12:00am PDT)

Now, if you have slightly more time, please continue reading the rest of this update!

[h1]Check Your Email for Early Access Keys[/h1]

If you have backed us at the [b]CARTOGRAPHER (£30)[/b] tier and above through Kickstarter or PayPal, you should have received an email with a detailed step-by-step on how to play Legrand Legacy’s early access demo. 

For backers in the EXPLORER (£40) tier and above, if you have downloaded our Beta demo, then your game will be automatically updated to the latest version and you don't have to do anything else.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/889/622/39b53fe0a9700134caa9e38e43a81939_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502506438&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5ac30299d58e810b1f67e9bbc268b3dd[/img][i]Check your emails! Or else...[/i]

If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing the early access demo, or if you have any feedback, please log them in our Steam discussion thread and we'll try to address them one by one:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/556740/discussions/0/1471967615872242417/

[h1]Volunteers for PAX West Seattle, USA (September 1-4)[/h1]

Legrand Legacy is coming to PAX West courtesy of [b]Indie Megabooth[/b] and [b]Intel[/b]! The truth is, this was the second time we applied for Indie Megabooth at PAX. Although we failed the first time, we decided to try again and this time, not only did we get selected, but Intel decided to sponsor us! *Excitement level over 9000*!!!

Henry and AJ will be there, but we're also looking for a volunteer to help us out at our booth because the PAX crowd is insane! If you fancy a free pass to PAX West and want to share the joy of Legrand Legacy with the world, please email us at [u][b]hello@semisoft.co[/b][/u]. Of course, we have prepared a special something for our volunteers :)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/037/86b319e33510825f1121c827853086bf_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502709641&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f63169769910e7db38260836210f5d8d[/img][i]Will you be our volunteer in PAX West?[/i]

These are the games that will be showcasing in this year's PAX West: http://indiemegabooth.com/event/pax-west-2017-3/

And this is our very own page: http://indiemegabooth.com/project/legrand-legacy/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/7b18fc56c52123b318d53e4592f5ceed2d7388ae.jpg[/img][i]Say hi to Finn and friends in PAX West![/i]

[h1]Gamescom Germany, Here We Come![/h1]

Another event that we will be attending is [b]Gamescom in Cologne, Germany (September 22-26)[/b] with special thanks to the kind folks at Indie Arena Booth. If you're going to be at Gamescom, please come say hi to Henry and AJ in Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.1 A-020).

These are the games that will be showcasing with Indie Arena Booth in Gamescom: http://indiegames.com/2017/07/indie_arena_booth_2017_announc.html

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/911/335/4d964a41dbddca6e39ac6f27039334ec_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1502703176&auto=format&q=92&s=b0d4b8ccd107eaa1cc14049d01b444b0[/img][i]New pop-artsy shirts for Gamescom & PAX West! Want one?[/i]
 
[h1]Last Call for Backers Survey (August 19th)[/h1]

Whether you're a Kickstarter or PayPal backer, you should have received your backers survey in your emails a few weeks ago. Please complete the survey as soon as possible. We need your most updated email and address to ensure that your digital and physical rewards will be delivered correctly. Most importantly, we are now finalizing most of the scenes in the game, including game credits, Fallen Gladiators of Legrand, and Monument of the Ancient. So please fill out the survey and make sure you tell us the names you want to put in the game according to the tier that you chose.

[b]LAST DAY TO SUBMIT YOUR SURVEY IS AUGUST 19th (12:00am PDT).[/b]

If you submit or make any changes to the survey after August 19th, we cannot guarantee that the name you requested will be correctly featured in the final game.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/089/12b5e7080694214e844c0e21b88de09e_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502709940&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=42dd6ad4a8a85c89b48e3b39c56b00f4[/img] [i]Fill out those surveys! Or else...[/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading[/h1]

Phew, that was ONE LONG UPDATE. In the mean time, hope you'll have a good time exploring Legrand in the early access demo! Thanks, and we'll report back next week with more fun stuff!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/017/912/859/923732f48370eee5d94e37e248fd2a53_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1502716628&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5c3527249f68f5b90bb763681e218bc6[/img][i]See you next week![/i]

-Revinia & The SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Console Poll Results, Tactical War, and Preparing for Japan
notes.content:
[h1]Drum Roll Please...[/h1]

Switch won!

Thanks to Reddit, our poll caught the internet's attention and we received a grand total of 3,495 votes in Twitter and Facebook. At first we thought PS4/PSVita would surely win, but by the end of the poll, about 1,600 Nintendo fans had shown their interest in Legrand Legacy for Switch.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/dc23c5ff8a0c1b1ce8a71a74a6f41b705f44f9bf.png[/img]
[i]Twitter & Facebook poll results[/i]

Now that the poll is over (and with such an overwhelming response for Switch), we have some important decisions to make. We are not a big studio and we have limited resources and budget, so our final decision will be based mainly on economic viability. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8d695e7732cd1bbca48ce4c8788a76f002a08188.png[/img]
[i]The news we posted on Facebook and Twitter[/i]

Rest assured whatever console we decide to port to, our Kickstarter and PayPal backers will be the first to know. However, you can still join us on our journey by subscribing to our weekly updates via [url=https://legrandlegacy.com/]legrandlegacy.com[/url].

[h1]Tactical War[/h1]

In the meantime, we've been pulling all-nighters in preparation for our Beta launch. One of the biggest features that will be making its debut appearance in our Beta is tactical war. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/645/230/31b09ad4688c8542fe9e4edc9bb1321d_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1494596665&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=53056c2692ad1678b3216519857d8f4b[/img]
[i]A GIF literally speaks a thousand words...[/i]

We haven't really talked about tactical war in details, but it was largely inspired by one of our favorite mechanics in Suikoden. We had so much fun creating strategies and putting our war general skills to the test while playing Suikoden that we can't help but to include a similar feature in our own game. 

Between the great war Mugna Feud and the tactical war feature, you may have realized that Legrand Legacy addresses the topic of war in a few aspects of the game. This is not unintentional and you will learn more as the story unfolds. We also consider this feature to be another story-telling mechanic through which you can experience our 6 heroes' progression.

Unfortunately we don't have a confirmed date for our Beta release yet, but stay tuned!

[h1]Konnichiwa Kyoto![/h1]

In preparation for our Japan trip, we decided to print a stack of Japanese brochures. This seemed like a good idea at first, but created quite a bit of chaos in the studio when we realized none of us speaks Japanese well (despite the fact that we're all JRPG fans). Thankfully, one of our team members, Aki, decided to roll up his sleeves and helped us with the translation. Hope we made our Japanese backers proud.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/20a56b66f145a06ea629161fa3f6e246390b79b3.png[/img]
[i]BitSummit here we come![/i]

Uwil is very nervous about having to speak in his limited Japanese, but he is definitely looking forward to playing other Kickstarter games that will be showcased in BitSummit. This will be his first time in Kyoto too so if you have any recommendations on places to visit, please let us know!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/1d694720200ecee45f55766e317901925bb8fd56.jpg[/img]
[i]The beautiful and majestic Kiyomizu Temple (photo courtesy of [url=http://www.planetware.com/tourist-attractions-/kyoto-jpn-ks-kyo.htm]planetware.com[/url])[/i]

[h1]Thanks for Reading![/h1]

It's been a hectic week but we're happy to share all the work that goes behind the scene. We also hope you enjoyed reading this update. We'll report back next week from the Indie Prize floor in Casual Connect Singapore and the Kickstarter Games area in BitSummit Kyoto!

-Revinia & The SEMISOFT Team-

notes.title: Nugaria - Smart, Young, and Deadly
notes.content:
As part of our Social Media Bonus Goal reward, we promised to include a new recruitable War General. Today we thought we'd let you have a sneak peek to Nugaria, a smart, young, and opinionated War General who was created with our Kickstarter backers in mind.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/287/936/b8508e6336f1d3ad1400ed0ea43a9197_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1492446222&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a81fe73345bb81e36f6dca06e4dacf3c[/img]

Nugaria is an adept general commanding a battalion hailing from the kingdom of Altea. Though still at a young age in comparison to the other generals, Nugaria has proven herself worthy of her rank. She joined the Altean army at a mere 16 years old and has since proven to her superiors that her combat prowess is to be respected by allies and feared by enemies.  

Although she can wield many different types of weapons, her weapon of choice is a dagger. Her lightning fast speed and powerful moves make Nugaria a deadly and fearsome combination. Nugaria also does not neglect her mind like many of her peers do. She studies in the ways of the war as much as she practices her dagger skills.

Fiercely loyal to the royal family of Altea, it is rumored that she in fact harbors feelings for one of the princes. Nugaria also too often wears her heart on her sleeves and isn't afraid to speak her mind, which often get her into hot water. Regardless of her shortcomings, she is a great valuable asset to the Altean army.  

[h1]Here’s the 3D model for Nugaria:[/h1]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/3d2ba8224e8f4adc9c9b140e22e2855c]Nugaria 3D Model[/url]

What do you think about this smart young War General?

As part of our Social Media Bonus Goal reward, we promised to include a new recruitable War General. Today we thought we'd let you have a sneak peek to Nugaria, a smart, young, and opinionated War General who was created with our Kickstarter backers in mind.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/287/936/b8508e6336f1d3ad1400ed0ea43a9197_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1492446222&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a81fe73345bb81e36f6dca06e4dacf3c[/img]

Nugaria is an adept general commanding a battalion hailing from the kingdom of Altea. Though still at a young age in comparison to the other generals, Nugaria has proven herself worthy of her rank. She joined the Altean army at a mere 16 years old and has since proven to her superiors that her combat prowess is to be respected by allies and feared by enemies.  

Although she can wield many different types of weapons, her weapon of choice is a dagger. Her lightning fast speed and powerful moves make Nugaria a deadly and fearsome combination. Nugaria also does not neglect her mind like many of her peers do. She studies in the ways of the war as much as she practices her dagger skills.

Fiercely loyal to the royal family of Altea, it is rumored that she in fact harbors feelings for one of the princes. Nugaria also too often wears her heart on her sleeves and isn't afraid to speak her mind, which often get her into hot water. Regardless of her shortcomings, she is a great valuable asset to the Altean army.  

[h1]Here’s the 3D model for Nugaria:[/h1]

[url=https://sketchfab.com/models/3d2ba8224e8f4adc9c9b140e22e2855c]Nugaria 3D Model[/url]

What do you think about this smart young War General?

notes.title: For the Dreamers...
notes.content:
[h1]A Song for the Dreamers in All of Us[/h1]

For today’s update we want to share a new original soundtrack titled “Eris’s Diary Theme”. Eris is a healer, a kind-hearted soul, but above all... a dreamer. Despite her weak physical condition, Eris never gives up on her dream to explore the world and she shares everything she hopes to experience in her little diary. We hope you’ll enjoy this soothing piece.  

https://youtu.be/u-ueC1R3HrU

[h1]Have You Heard of Pine?[/h1]  

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/twirlbound/pine-an-action-adventure-game-that-adapts-to-you]Pine[/url] is a gorgeous action adventure game inspired by the adventures of Link in the Zelda-series, the intriguing nemesis system of Shadow of Mordor, Fable's choice-dependent progression and the dance-like combat of Bloodborne. 

So far they have raised more than 80% of their €100,000 goal with 4 days remaining in their campaign. Help these 6 students make their dream game a reality! You can read more about the dev's story in their [url=http://imgur.com/gallery/D3WMh]Imgur post.[/url]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/016/158/282/757d62c395f3157abd0a53258a1112c8_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1491487513&auto=format&lossless=true&s=d19dc0068ab3b436f204df591627d9e8[/img]

That's all for today's update. We hope you’re enjoying your journey through the new regions in our Alpha demo. There are a bunch of new features added so don’t forget to chat with random strangers you meet in the street - you’ll never know what they have to offer or what story they have to tell.

See you next week!  

-Revinia & Legrand Legacy Team-

notes.title: Alpha Has Landed (New Screenshots Included)
notes.content:
[h1]Calling All Adventurers and Beyond![/h1]  
If you have backed us at the Adventurer tier (£50) and above, you should have received an email with a detailed step-by-step on how to access Legrand Legacy’s Alpha demo. Please note that the Alpha is available via Steam only, but don't worry, you will still get the DRM-free copy when Legrand Legacy is officially released in September 2017.  

If you missed our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/984434986/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/description]Kickstarter[/url] or don’t have a credit card, fret not, you can still support us via our [url=https://paypal.legrandlegacy.com/]PayPal[/url].  

[h1]What’s All the Fuss About?[/h1]  
The story will pick up where we left off at the end of our Pre-Alpha. Finn and Aria continue on their journey to two very different yet wildly fascinating regions, where they are met with new creatures, new characters, and possibly a few new NPCs to recruit. However, in true Legrand Legacy fashion, not everyone is who they seem to be - who are these mysterious new characters and what secrets do they hold? 

[h1]Sounds Fun, What Else?[/h1]

We took your feedback from the Pre-Alpha and have made improvements in several aspects, including battle system, user interface, visual effects, script, cutscenes, music, and sound effects. Here are a few screenshots taken from the Alpha to show you some of these changes.  

[b]BATTLE SYSTEM[/b]

The most important thing to note is the battle system. At the beginning of our Kickstarter, we put out [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/984434986/legrand-legacy-tale-of-the-fatebounds/posts/1790535]two different versions[/url] of the Pre-Alpha to get an idea of which battle system everyone enjoys more. Most of you preferred B version, where the ACT appears at the beginning of each turn, so this is the battle system that we will be using going forward. Also, you can now choose WASD or ABXY, depending on whether you play with a keyboard or a controller. You also have the option to switch to one ACT position (not random) if you just want to enjoy the story and prefer an easier journey through Legrand.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/2e8b7db39b58fab5a3b74d16e9c251e4fc033abb.png[/img]
[i]Feel the wrath of Finn's Arc Slash![/i]

[b]BATTLE UI & STATS[/b]

In addition, you can now see a monster’s stats, including its type and weaknesses so you can plan your attacks accordingly. Did anyone notice the new character portraits?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/309688a36dedf3da6f5cf53f769ad418f6765131.png[/img]
[i]Why so serious?[/i]

[b]VISUAL EFFECTS[/b]

Remember Klahmaran? Well, he’s back with more fire than ever before! Finn and Aria better step up their game.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/4eb13b6827dfeac7d1255cd440052368ee39fa88.png[/img]
[i]Watch out for the burning man![/i]

[b]MUSIC[/b]

To celebrate the Alpha release, join Finn as he literally runs through some of the regions in Legrand in the new soundtrack video below.

[url=https://youtu.be/-SdXRAAxh2U]Legrand Legacy OST | Amidst the Breeze[/url]

There are other notable changes too, but you just have to play the demo to find out more!  

[h1]Help! I Spot Some Bugs![/h1] 

We’ve worked very hard to iron out most of the wrinkles, however please bear in mind this is an Alpha after all - some bugs and rough spots are to be expected. Part of what makes this community unique is that you get to shape the game as it is developing. As such, we appreciate it if you can email us with any problems, issues, or concerns at [b]support@semisoft.co[/b] or log them through the link below so we can address each and every one of them!

https://semisoft.freshdesk.com/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26865303/8e01aaf8c2e67915b6792e5a3d86d23c45a0981d.png[/img]
[i]Click on the Freshdesk link above and open a "New Support Ticket" to log any issues with the Alpha demo[/i]
 
[h1]What Do You Think?[/h1]

This Alpha phase marks a major milestone for all of us at Semisoft and we are thrilled to share this exciting journey with you. So what do you think? Do you like how Legrand Legacy's Alpha sounds? Please let us know if you managed to discover some of the fun Easter eggs we sneaked in there and if you have recorded a playthrough video, don't forget to share it with us!

- Revinia & Team Legrand Legacy -

notes.title: Version A vs. Version B
notes.content:
By now you’ve probably played the new version B of our Pre-Alpha. You may be wondering, what’s the difference behind this new version and the previous one (version A)?

[b]VERSION A[/b] is the original Pre-Alpha that we launched with our first Kickstarter. If you watch YouTube Let’s Play videos dated before January 18th, 2017, they are most likely playing this build. Version A is available only on GameJolt.

[b]VERSION B[/b] is the revised Pre-Alpha that we launched with this new Kickstarter. We took your feedback from last time and have implemented some changes into this new build. Version B is available on Steam as well as on GameJolt.

Now let’s talk about some of the things that have changed in Version B.

[h1]Battle UI[/h1]

A big change for version B is that we now have an additional user interface which gives you detailed information about the enemy. This includes, for example, monster type, element type, weakness, and HP bar. Our goal is to make it easier for you to plan your attack and defense actions.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/452/e0d1683ca42bb8b67a45750f21a43e2d_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485320742&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b093b9ac355290c4118c0a98e6a66813[/img]

[h1]Action Circle Tempo (ACT)[/h1]

You will notice that ACT now only appears at the beginning of combat. Also, based on popular request, you can now choose your own flavor for ACT depending on the desired playing experience:  

•	You can choose either to press a fixed button (easier) or to get randomized buttons (harder)

•	You can choose either to have a fixed (easier) or randomized (harder) Perfect/Good area

•	The arrows in version A have been replaced with ABXY, which we hope will make it more intuitive

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/488/70cd8b2dcd7181868e94c2e465e31ad0_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321045&auto=format&lossless=true&s=be869230df6d346155b93e41d50cf23e[/img]

[h1]Character’s Skill Attribute[/h1]

At the end of the battle, you can now immediately add Attribute Points (ATP) to level up your character.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/015/279/504/6632f447b9292b94310c54369a691978_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1485321178&auto=format&lossless=true&s=97892e3bc67cd65b345e8a675106485b[/img]

[h1]Other Cosmetic Changes[/h1]

You may also notice several cosmetic changes which we hope will make your experience more enjoyable. These include enhanced visual effects, improved textures for some monsters, map pointers, and more!

[h1]Why do we have two versions of the Pre-Alpha?[/h1]

We want Legrand Legacy to be a game that YOU enjoy, so we will be conducting a poll after the Kickstarter is over to gather your feedback about both versions so that we can know into which direction to take the Legrand Legacy gameplay.

[url=https://ksr-video.imgix.net/assets/015/279/540/bdc6c2ed73396eba15ed61b7a4aabad3_h264_high.mp4]check the video here![/url]

But for now, we do want to hear from you! Do you prefer the ACT dial to appear right before each attack and defense action (as is the case for version A) or all at once at the beginning of combat (as it happens now in version B)? Please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: Live 2D: Bringing Characters to Life
notes.content:
Hi! We wanted to start today's update by mentioning that Legrand Legracy is now part of Kickstarter's Projects We Love! Be sure to share the image below on social media to show your support!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/639/716/acc3a6444d846cdce171870bb9863f55_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479921380&auto=format&q=92&s=7e8afcc24e1a5a2169ca426fd044f838[/img]

An RPG like Legrand Legacy consists of many different components, from characterization, script writing, world and game design, not to mention its original soundtrack! Today we want to take you on a tour behind the scenes of the game’s production so that we can talk about a very important feature of Legrand Legacy: Live 2D.

If you have tried the Legrand Legacy Pre-alpha Prologue you’ll know that the game uses visual novel style conversations combined with Live 2D for its story and to convey the characters’ emotions. An animated expression truly creates a more dynamic experience compared to a static image!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/984/f788ff7f980228c038a03ad64a851ab9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479889069&auto=format&q=92&s=490345c637ac02ad7219bd2ed17ac2e4[/img]

Now, let's talk about the actual process to make this all happen. Generally speaking, there are four steps to bring the characters' emotions alive thanks to Live 2D.

Step 1: Prepare the Original Drawing: First, the artist will prepare an image of the character. It’s best to use an image with less shading in some areas like the eyes, eyebrows, nose, ears, and mouth, because too much shading will complicate the slicing process.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/634/936/ab1ddbcc30e229e52c1c5be8c3ebe15f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1479888358&auto=format&q=92&s=30ab4ccca09ad19f4c4cc962f64eb282[/img]

2. Create a Model : Next, we continue to modelling by using the Live 2D Cubism Modeler. We set the parameters for a character’s facial features, all depending on the expression we want to present. In this case we could, for example, change the angle of her eyebrows or the shape of her mouth.
